module: Flowgraph node "Get Traffic State" (repeat_instant). Reads the traffic state (gameplay_traffic.getState: on, off, spawning, loading) and the vehicle count: outputs flow on/spawning/loading/off, onBool, state, amount (getNumOfTraffic), activeAmount (getNumOfTraffic(true), from the vehicle pool).

work.desc: Writes the traffic state and counters to the outputs every frame.
